_comment: Free things for kids and families across Ireland.

items.name: National Museum of Ireland
items.blurb: Free entry at all four sites: Archaeology, Natural History (the 'Dead Zoo'), Decorative Arts and Country Life in Mayo.

items.name: National Gallery of Ireland
items.blurb: Free entry, family trails and a great café. Look for the Jack B. Yeats room.

items.name: Chester Beatty
items.blurb: Free museum of manuscripts and treasures from around the world, inside Dublin Castle's gardens.

items.name: National Botanic Gardens
items.blurb: Free glasshouses, squirrels and a river walk in Glasnevin.

items.name: Heritage Ireland free first Wednesdays
items.blurb: Many OPW heritage sites — castles, abbeys and gardens — are free on the first Wednesday of every month.

items.name: Your local library
items.blurb: Free membership, free books, free events, free Wi-Fi. Ask about Summer Stars and Spring into Storytime.

items.name: Cúla4
items.blurb: TG4's free Irish-language channel and app for kids — cartoons, games and songs as Gaeilge.

items.name: RTÉjr
items.blurb: Free shows, podcasts and games from RTÉ's kids' channel.

items.name: CoderDojo
items.blurb: Free volunteer-led coding clubs for 7–17 year olds. It started in Cork in 2011 and is now worldwide.

items.name: junior parkrun
items.blurb: Free 2 km timed runs for 4–14 year olds every Sunday morning.

items.name: Ask About Ireland
items.blurb: Free learning resources about Irish history, geography and nature from Ireland's libraries.

items.name: Phoenix Park
items.blurb: Europe's largest enclosed city park: wild deer, the Visitor Centre and Ashtown Castle are free.
